mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.25% reduces the discount rate for equity cash flows, creating favorable conditions for positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in accommodative monetary policy.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate to 0.25% or lower triggers aggressive central bank stimulus, reducing equity discount rates and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS drops below 0.25%, SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous low FEDFUNDS (<0.25%) and low CPIAUCSL (<230) indicate accommodative policy amid stable inflation, reducing equity risk premiums and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS < 0.25% and CPIAUCSL < 230, SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% signals labor market weakness that prompts central bank rate cuts, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as stimulus expectations rise.
failure_condition: When UNRATE exceeds 5.0%, SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 900 thousand units indicate residential sector contraction, triggering central bank stimulus and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST falls below 900, SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous housing starts below 900 and real services sales below 400,000 million dollars indicate broad consumer sector weakness, prompting aggressive stimulus and positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: When HOUST < 900 and RSAFS < 400000, SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 97.0 indicates manufacturing slowdown, triggering central bank stimulus and positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days during high economic uncertainty.
failure_condition: When INDPRO falls below 97.0, SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of cases during high uncertainty.

mechanism_narrative: Payroll employment below 133,000 thousand signals labor market deterioration, prompting rate cuts that generate positive S&P 500 returns over 5 days in late-cycle economic phases.
failure_condition: When PAYEMS drops below 133,000, SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of late-cycle instances.
